items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: I've tried Kimball's violin, but I couldn't make any headway with it because it's strung up times.

ctx.x: You played left-handed, though, in those days, too,

and you started... I still, yeah. That's just the way I taught. That's the way I am today. I've never changed. I've never... I've tried Kimball's violin, but I couldn't make any headway with it because it's strung up times. I couldn't even make a C chord on his instrument because it's awkward to me. It's like a left-hand man would grab my violin and couldn't play my violin. I grab his violin, I can't play his violin because mine's strung up for right-handed. And it's just...
When you started out, did you pick or bow mostly?
